scope: synthetic local example only: one account, one currency, one closed period, immutable snapshots; target-enterprise semantic owner and acceptance are missing

definitions.definition: A synthetic immutable bank-side record identified by transactionId.
A synthetic immutable internal-ledger record identified by transactionId.
One bank record and one ledger record sharing reference, referenceVersion, currency, integer amountMinor, and bookingDate in the same closed-period snapshot.
Non-empty stable string identity within one source snapshot.
Integer monetary amount in the currency minor unit; floating-point values are not permitted.
Three-letter currency code; this slice accepts one declared snapshot currency only.
Business reference used with referenceVersion as the exact matching reference.
Version label for a reference; a reference without its version is not a match key.
ISO calendar date within the declared closed period.
